hero.eyebrow: A home for devotion and belonging · San Jose, California
hero.headline: A place to gather. A tradition to carry forward.
hero.lead: Durga Bari is a community-led spiritual and cultural home dedicated to Maa Durga. We come together in worship, share our traditions, and make space for the next generation to belong.

layout.headline: Rooted in devotion. Open to everyone.
layout.body: What begins with worship grows through the people who show up: families, volunteers, artists, teachers, and neighbors. Durga Bari is being shaped by that shared care.

items.title: Worship
items.body: A sacred space to pray, observe, and celebrate together.

items.title: Culture
items.body: Music, language, festivals, and traditions passed from one generation to the next.

items.title: Community
items.body: A welcoming place to meet, serve, and build lasting connections.

hero.headline: A vision made real, one gathering at a time.

layout.headline: The community is the beginning.
layout.body: Durga Bari is a community-led initiative to build a lasting home for worship, learning, and cultural life. Before any building, there are people who choose to gather, listen, and offer their time.

layout.headline: A foundation made of people.
layout.body: These early moments of worship and connection are part of Durga Bari’s foundation. Each gathering gives the vision a little more shape.

layout.headline: A lasting foundation.
layout.body: A three-year pledge of $100 per month ($3,600 total) supports the foundation of Durga Bari. The circle is limited to the first 200 families. Supporters are recognized in non-voting donor categories; governance remains with the Board under the bylaws.

layout.headline: Questions about giving?
layout.body: We would be glad to talk through the options with you.
